order_rule: Rotate the four listed arms by zero, one, two, three places for tasks one through four.
selection_rule: All four known P29 development tasks, fourth model-response boundary regardless of success or later trajectory. If any fixed boundary is ineligible, stop before inference; do not substitute a later state or another task.
runtime_rule: Keep reconstructs recorded Python prefix with inert saved API replies. Reset begins a fresh namespace once. All later calls persist in both conditions. The model receives an accurate condition-specific runtime notice.
environment_rule: Re-execute recorded prefix APIs in a fresh isolated simulated world. Require exact public observations, discovered schemas and saved DB bytes before continuation. No environment effects are duplicated in the original world.
budget_rule: Continuation limits are identical in all cells. Original prefix API usage is charged against the original task API cap. Prefix reconstruction is separate experimental setup, recorded per cell and not claimed to be deployment-free. Continuation seed starts at original seed plus four.
